competition_law_note: Stage/venue law (owner 2026-10-07 expansion instruction item 4): a soccer match is BET-ELIGIBLE only when the B1 target semantics and the bookmaker h2h settlement semantics are the SAME regulation result. The frozen B1 target is 3-way FULL-TIME 90/120-min with shootouts never flipping it (soccer_b1_replay.make_target), while Pinnacle soccer 1X2 settles on 90 minutes — so any match where extra time is possible is NOT_RUN_STAGE_LAW. Venue law: the frozen adapter passes neutral=False (HCA applies to the listed home side), so only competitions whose format guarantees true home-and-away in the window are eligible; anything else is NOT_RUN. A kickoff date with no covering law window is UNKNOWN -> NOT_RUN (fail-closed; never guessed).

soccer_uefa_nations_league.evidence: UEFA Nations League 2026-27 league phase (matchdays Sep-Nov 2026): home-and-away double headers, regulation 90-minute results, draws stand — no extra time and no neutral venues, so B1 full-time target == Pinnacle 1X2 (90-min) semantics and neutral=False (HCA on the listed home side) is correct.

UNL knockout stage (quarter-final ties and March/June Final Four): single decisive matches where extra time and penalties are possible — B1 target (90/120-min full-time, shootout=draw) diverges from the bookmaker's 90-minute h2h settlement; also single-venue finals may be neutral. Fail-closed NOT_RUN per the owner's same-result law.
